title: Hell's Angels chief zapped at Skinwalker Ranch

tellings.quote: has another story of a Hell's Angels chief or whatever, you know, getting zapped and then a catatonic steak just just, you know, paralyzed there.

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, passes on a story from Brandon Fugal, owner of Skinwalker Ranch, a property in Utah famous for reports of strange events. According to Michels, Fugal tells of a leader of the Hell's Angels motorcycle club who got "zapped" there and was left frozen, catatonic and paralysed on the spot. It is told as one more example of the ranch's power to harm people.
